title: Future-dated signatures are accepted
issue: A timestamped signature may be accepted when its signing time is later than the verification time, even when max_age is set. Fix the validation so future-dated signatures are rejected with SignatureExpired when age validation is requested. Preserve existing valid and expired signature behavior and the behavior when max_age is omitted. The repository includes a failing regression test.
public_test_origin: Upstream regression test from reference commit
